name: Last.fm Popularity Rating
author: Tyler Childerhose
description: Sets track star ratings from Last.fm popularity, ranking each track against the artist's most popular tracks

api_key.title: Last.fm API key
api_key.description: Required for Last.fm API requests. Create an API key at https://www.last.fm/api/account/create.

cron.title: Schedule (cron)
cron.description: Cron schedule for library scans. A scan may stop at the 25-second run budget and resume on the next run.

batch_size.title: Songs per run
batch_size.description: Maximum songs processed per user per scan. Scans may stop sooner at the run budget and resume from the saved position.

top_tracks_limit.title: Top tracks considered
top_tracks_limit.description: Maximum tracks requested from Last.fm's all-time artist top tracks. Ratings use listener-count percentiles within the returned list; tracks absent from a nonempty list get 0 stars. If no tracks are returned, ratings are unchanged.

cache_ttl_days.title: Cache duration (days)
cache_ttl_days.description: How long new Last.fm results are cached. Changing this does not alter existing cache expirations. Last.fm's artist top-track endpoint has no time-period parameter, so shorter caching does not provide recent-window data.

overwrite_existing.title: Overwrite existing ratings
overwrite_existing.description: Re-rate songs that already have a rating. With a nonempty Last.fm top-track list, absent songs are set to 0 stars; if no list is available, ratings are unchanged. Off: only unrated songs are processed.

plexamp_mode.title: Plexamp Mode (1 star for chart matches)
plexamp_mode.description: Give 1 star to every track found in the artist's Last.fm top tracks instead of assigning 1-5 stars by listener-count percentile.

verbose_logging.title: Verbose logging
verbose_logging.description: Log listener counts, rating outcomes, and skip reasons for songs the plugin evaluates.

kvstore.reason: Cache Last.fm results and remember scan progress

scheduler.reason: Process the library in periodic batches

subsonicapi.reason: List songs and set ratings through the Subsonic API

users.reason: Required by subsonicapi to act on behalf of users
